_comment: Advanced AI Workflows — settings.json snippet. Merge these entries into your project's .claude/settings.json. The setup-with-claude skill does this automatically when invoked.

PostToolUse._comment: Auto-trigger hook for gstack-to-plans. Fires ONLY when a Write tool call targets a path under the user's .gstack/projects/ directory whose filename matches the gstack design-doc pattern. Both the written path and the prefix are normalised through path.resolve before comparison - the version before 2026-09-01 compared a native path against a string built as homedir + '/.gstack/projects/', which on Windows is a mixed-separator prefix no real path matches, so the hook could never fire there. The hook surfaces /gstack-to-plans to the user in Claude's next turn; it does not invoke it autonomously.

hooks.command: node -e "const path=require('path'),os=require('os');const raw=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH||'';const norm=s=>{const r=path.resolve(s).split(path.sep).join('/');return process.platform==='win32'?r.toLowerCase():r;};if(raw){const p=norm(raw);const prefix=norm(path.join(os.homedir(),'.gstack','projects'))+'/';if(p.startsWith(prefix)&&/-design-\d/i.test(path.basename(raw))){console.log('[aaw-hook] gstack design doc written: '+raw);console.log('[aaw-hook] Suggestion: invoke /gstack-to-plans to archive this design doc into .advanced-plans/specs/');}}" 2>/dev/null || true

_merge_instructions.permissions.allow: Append the four .advanced-plans/** entries to the existing permissions.allow array. Do not duplicate entries that already exist.
_merge_instructions.hooks.PostToolUse: Append the Write matcher entry to the existing PostToolUse array. If a PostToolUse Write matcher already exists, add this hook to its hooks array rather than creating a duplicate matcher. If that array already holds a hook whose command mentions [aaw-hook] but does not match the command here, it is a SUPERSEDED copy from an earlier setup run: replace it, do not append beside it. Appending is how a machine ends up running a fixed hook and the bug it replaced at the same time - and the broken one is silent, so nobody would notice.
_merge_instructions.scope_note: The PostToolUse Write hook checks CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH at runtime. It fires only when the written path starts with ~/.gstack/projects/ AND the filename matches the gstack design-doc pattern (*-design-{datetime}.*). Writes to any other path produce no output and exit 0 — the hook does not interfere with normal development.
_merge_instructions.windows_note: os.homedir() is cross-platform, but it returns a NATIVE path - C:\Users\name with backslashes - so concatenating '/.gstack/projects/' onto it produces a prefix that matches nothing. That was a real defect, shipped and inert on Windows until 2026-09-01; it is why both sides now go through path.resolve and are compared with separators normalised to '/' and, on win32, lowercased. tests/packaging/test-hook-path.sh runs the shipped command against native, POSIX and mixed path shapes, and mutates the normalisation away to prove those cases can fail.
_merge_instructions.debounce_note: Idempotency is provided by the gstack-to-plans SKILL.md itself (Step 3: if destination is identical to source, it is a no-op). The hook fires per-write but the skill exits cleanly on re-run with no new content — satisfying REG-7 sub-case (d).
